title: Monitor that fails when a disposition changes without an evidence delta and a recorded reason
question: Implementation target: a monitor that compares the disposition set between two registry versions and fails when any candidate's disposition changed without an accompanying evidence delta and a written reason, so dispositions cannot silently drift between waves.

schema_pack.note: schema pack present; fragment not separately re-validated here

monitor.rule: After applying the id migration map, a classification change is SILENT_DRIFT (fail) unless at least one named evidence field changed AND a non-empty disposition_change_reason is written on the v2 record. The finding lists the evidence field names, not a boolean that something moved. A rename that preserves classification is RENAME_ONLY, not a disposition change.

findings.reason: wrapper added after an unrecorded hallway conversation
Content exported to a named preservation location before RETIRE.
Smoke case constructed and passed; ADOPT-AS-IS is no longer an untested assertion.

both_states.silent_on: command-center/p2-wave/probes/WFA-0075/fixtures/v2_documented.json (classification changes with named evidence-field deltas and reasons)
both_states.verbatim_silent: fail=False silent_drift_ids=[] documented_ids=['wf-doc-preserve', 'wf-doc-smoke'] rename_only_ids=['wf-rename-new'] smoke_fields=['smoke_run'] preserve_fields=['preservation_proof']

negative_controls.rejects: v2_silent: classification changes lacking evidence-field delta and/or written reason (both-missing, reason-hole, evidence-hole)
a monitor that alarms on any classification change, which cannot discriminate documented drift from silent drift
negative_controls.observed: documented_pair fail=False documented_ids=['wf-doc-preserve', 'wf-doc-smoke'] fields smoke=['smoke_run'] preserve=['preservation_proof']

negative_controls.rejects: treating wf-rename-old -> wf-rename-new as a disposition change instead of consuming the id migration map
negative_controls.observed: kind=RENAME_ONLY v1_id=wf-rename-old v2_id=wf-rename-new fail=False; without_map kinds={'wf-rename-new': 'ADDED', 'wf-rename-old': 'REMOVED'}

claims.claim: Three planted silent classification changes against the synthetic v1 baseline are all caught.
Documented classification changes with evidence-field deltas and written reasons are not flagged, and the monitor names the evidence fields that moved.
A renamed candidate joined through the id migration map is RENAME_ONLY, not a disposition change.

evidence.mechanism: monitor.compare fail-set on v1 vs v2_silent

evidence.claim: documented pair stays silent and names fields
evidence.mechanism: evidence_fields_changed set algebra on named evidence keys; compare kind=DOCUMENTED only when reason is also written
resolve_id follows aliases transitively before join

evidence.verbatim: fails when any candidate's disposition changed without an accompanying evidence delta and a written reason

reviewer.method: Probe2 does not trust compare().fail for the documented pair. It recomputes evidence field diffs from the two JSON maps, walks the reverse alias list to join wf-rename-new back to wf-rename-old, re-runs the silent pair as the both-states control, and shows a without-map run emitting REMOVED+ADDED instead of RENAME_ONLY.

residual_unknowns: The catalog v1 baseline 08-WORKFLOW-CANDIDATE-REGISTRY.json is not mounted on this worktree (hits=none). The monitor is proven on a synthetic v1/v2 pair with the same 13-field candidate shape (classification, evidence object, id).

WFA-0010 (id migration map) and WFA-0068 (disposition decision procedure) artifacts are absent. WFA-0075 consumes a fixture map with the same alias-row contract and compares the classification field; it does not re-derive dispositions.
Declared output_schema wfa-schema-pack.json#/$defs/RegressionFixture present=True. This unit does not author the WFA-0001 pack.
